newsitem.title: USA: Racotek narrows Q3 loss, cuts use of cash.
newsitem.headline: Racotek narrows Q3 loss, cuts use of cash.

text.p: Racotek Inc, narrowing its third-quarter loss, said for the third consecutive quarter it reduced its use of cash.

Cash and investments decreased by $1.4 million during the quarter compared to $2.1 million during the second quarter and $3.1 million during the first quarter of this year, said David Maenke, chief financial officer, in a statement.
Maenke said continued control helped bring operating losses down 14 percent from the previous quarter.

Earlier Monday, Racotek, which develops software products to facilitate mobile workgroup computing, reported a third-quarter loss of $1,972,000 or $0.08 per share compared to a year-earlier loss of $2.6 million or $0.11 per share. Average shares increased to 24.5 million from 23.8 million. Net revenues for the quarter were $1,874,000 compared to $1,938,000 in the same year-ago period.
